attributes.board_name: Pennsylvania State Board of Veterinary Medicine

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved by the Board (49 Pa. Code §31.16); office management or practice building courses do not count
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE is not required for initial licensure.
rules.audit_note: Keep a list of courses and certificates of attendance at least 5 years.
rules.notes: 30 clock hours in the 24 months before renewal; max 25% individual study or written/computer-based correspondence courses with third-party verification. Licenses expire November 30 of even-numbered years.
